title: Hosted release reads package manager version outside its nested checkout
reproduction: Run Hosted release from synchronized main with a valid immutable aidream SHA and existing required repository secrets.
Credential preflight and both nested checkouts succeed.
pnpm/action-setup runs at workspace root without package_json_file although extension package.json is in matrx-extend/; observe setup failure before dependency installation.
expected: The hosted runner selects the package manager declared by the checked-out extension and proceeds to strict release verification.
actual: Run37092816878 failed with No pnpm version is specified at pnpm/action-setup; no package was produced.
retest_result: Run37093086895 passed pnpm/action-setup, Node, uv, and frozen install; the job later failed check:matrx-packages without publishing a candidate.
